item.title: DBS CEO Tan Says Market Is Repricing Risks on AI Financing
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP estimates Asia’s spending on data centers could reach $8.2 trillion by 2050. DBS has originated about S$25 billion ($20 billion) of AI deals this year, often as lead manager on syndicated loans and has held only a fraction of that, Tan said. The financing is mostly for hardware, from semiconductors and memory chips to data centers, she added.

item.title: Iran War’s End Will Be Turning Point for India, Amundi Arm Says
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: An end to the Iran war may prove a turning point for India given its reliance on oil imports, Alessia Berardi, head of global macroeconomics and emerging markets strategy at Amundi Investment Institute, said in an interview in Mumbai last week. “I’m quite positive,” she added, citing improving private investment and other economic data.
